resources.string: Start sharing in Qovrion Desktop, then enter its local-network address. Qovrion will show the same six-digit confirmation code on both devices.
Approve on the desktop only when every digit matches. A different code can indicate the wrong computer or an intercepted connection.
Prompts, source code and transcripts are not requested. Qovrion uses mutual TLS, compares both device identities, pins the desktop certificate and encrypts credentials and cached usage on this phone.
Showing the last encrypted offline snapshot
Forgetting locally does not revoke the old credential on the desktop. Use it only when the desktop is unavailable, then remove the old device there later.
The desktop is paired, but no usage snapshot has been downloaded yet.
